page.subtitle: CI on the platform's own repository: how long PRs wait in the merge queue, how long jobs wait for a runner, and how long each job and step takes on each runner

state.loadFailed: Could not load the CI data

sweep.never: Not swept yet: the backend reads GitHub every 5 minutes, and this page is empty until the first sweep
sweep.owed: Last sweep {at}; jobs of {owed} runs not read yet
sweep.backfilling: Last sweep {at}. Still backfilling: the data covers only {from} onwards; jobs of {owed} runs not read yet
sweep.error: The last sweep did not finish: {error}

note.noSample: Nothing to measure in this window.
note.queue: From a PR's first entry into the merge queue to its merge, including time spent ejected and re-queued.
note.wait: From a job being created (everything it needs has finished) to it starting on a runner.
note.ci: The first attempt of a full-tier Required CI run: from the run being created to its last job finishing. Draft-tier and cancelled runs are left out, and so is the wait before a re-run.
note.rounds: Across {prs} merged PRs, the mean number of Required CI runs on pull_request events that reached a result (success or failure); {more} needed more than one. In the merge queue: {queue} runs on average.
note.roundsIncomplete: CI history starts at {from}; {n} merged PRs may have earlier CI rounds missing from these counts.
note.historyUnknown: CI history coverage has not been recorded; the round counts may be incomplete.
note.flaky: {runs} of {of} Required CI runs with a result: the latest attempt passed after an earlier attempt on the same commit had a failed job.
note.busy: Mean of per-minute samples; peak {peak}. Of busy runner time, PR CI took {pr}, the merge queue {queue}, builds and deploys on main {main}.
note.busyChart: Mean of per-minute samples within each hour.
note.depth: The most PRs in the merge queue in each hour, and the most jobs running at once in the same hour.

chart.queue: Merge queue time (min, by merge day)
chart.depth: Merge queue length and job peak (hourly)
chart.hourOfDay: Mean jobs running in each hour of the day (UTC)
chart.rounds: PR CI rounds per merged PR
chart.ejections: Why the merge queue removed PRs
